summary: 2-shot both-orders redundancy judge on exp046 base
hypothesis: Adding a recall-tilted redundancy judge with 2-shot exemplars in both orders on top of the exp046 count=8 pipeline should reduce redundancy and lift overall quality, because surfacing both orderings of pairwise comparisons guards against position bias and the recall tilt should preserve coverage.
technique: The exp046 pipeline (count=8 base) is extended with a model-based redundancy judge that runs each candidate pair in both orders (both-orders voting) with 2-shot in-context exemplars, tilted toward recall — implemented as a deterministic-select stage driven by those pairwise model calls.
result: Scored 0.347 on the full-30 gate (1 win / 1 tie / 27 losses vs Sonnet), with specPass=100% but rubric scores of atom=4, spec=3, cover=3, nat=3, nonRed=3. Despite the redundancy judge, quality did not improve over prior experiments — coverage and redundancy remained at 3 — and the run was discarded.
label: exp053
